description: Implements configurable retry logic with exponential or fixed backoff for failed adapter calls. Fires automatically when an adapter returns a 429 (rate limit) or 5xx (server error) response, or when a network timeout occurs. Reads the adapter's retry_policy from the catalog (max_retries, backoff_strategy, initial_delay_ms) and re-attempts the call accordingly. After all retries are exhausted, it marks the adapter as FAILED and triggers on_failure_alert_hook for downstream alerting. Critical for handling transient failures from external APIs like CIBIL, Experian, and GSTN.
use_cases: Recovering from transient 500/503 errors in bureau API calls
Handling rate-limit (429) throttling from GSTN or Twilio
Network timeout recovery for slow government APIs
Automatic retry before escalating to failure alert
when_to_use: Attach to any adapter that makes external HTTP calls and has a retry_policy defined. Universally applicable but especially important for government APIs and credit bureaus that experience rate limits.
trigger_condition: On adapter call failure returning 429, 5xx, or network timeout

input_parameters.description: HTTP status code that triggered the retry
Maximum retries allowed from adapter catalog policy
Delay in milliseconds before first retry
Retry delay growth strategy: fixed or exponential

output.on_failure: Max retries exhausted; triggers on_failure_alert_hook; marks adapter FAILED in simulation report
